# Third-party material

## react-body-highlighter (MIT)

`lib/body-geometry.json` contains the polygon coordinates of the front and back
body figure from [giavinh79/react-body-highlighter](https://github.com/giavinh79/react-body-highlighter)
(`src/assets/index.ts`, v2.0.5, MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 GV79). Only the
geometry was taken, not the React code. The shapes are re-keyed to this app's
muscle ids; the joint circles and the grouping are this repo's own. The full
licence text is in `react-body-highlighter.LICENSE`.
